cases.name: secp256k1_public_key_ecdsa_fast
cases.notes: Full-width 254-bit scalar. Native API validates input and returns compressed SEC1; baseline key/curve setup and SEC1 output encoding are outside measurement.
cases.fixture_provenance: generate-curves.py independent Python affine arithmetic; fixed non-secret scalars; ECDSA algebra checked before emitting; BLS standard generators checked for curve and subgroup membership.

cases.name: secp256k1_verify_ecdsa_fast
cases.notes: Valid low-S compact signature, fixed digest and key. Native key/signature decoding is measured; baseline key/signature decoding is outside measurement.
cases.fixture_provenance: generate-curves.py independent Python affine arithmetic; fixed non-secret scalars; ECDSA algebra checked before emitting; BLS standard generators checked for curve and subgroup membership.
